description.comment: This sample represents a MAG derived from metagenomic run SRR38270382 (source BioSample SAMN57467778; raw reads BioProject PRJNA1457641). Original genome ID: L1HIL1200252-GF03EGPP_1_bin.50. Original source description: pool water metagenome. Sampling location: China: Henan Province, Xijugang Village. Original CheckM estimates: completeness 76.26%; contamination 2.133%. GTDB classification: d__Bacteria;p__Pseudomonadota;c__Gammaproteobacteria;o__Burkholderiales;f__Burkholderiaceae_B;g__Hydrogenophaga;s__Hydrogenophaga pseudoflava. Additional submission of the same MAG in BioProject PRJEB129169. Original analysis ERZ30427385 in PRJEB128554, derived sample ERS32116848, was reported FAILED in the 2026-10-29 submission-scope snapshot. Sequence content, source-read references and quality estimates are retained.
